stories.h: King County court filing portal offline through Nov. 30
stories.s: The clerk's KC Script portal stays down after a vendor's cybersecurity warning collided with planned maintenance. Officials say nothing was breached, and filings are going through email, fax and in person.

stories.h: Seattle schools to pay $600K in pregnancy accommodation case
stories.s: In a settlement with the Attorney General, Seattle Public Schools will pay $600,000 and adopt new policies for pregnant and nursing staff, including five-day responses to accommodation requests.

stories.h: Person in crisis closes 2nd Avenue downtown for hours
stories.s: Emergency crews closed southbound 2nd Avenue between Pine and Union for hours Tuesday while they responded to a person in crisis.

coming.h: King tide flood watch for south King shorelines
coming.s: A coastal flood watch for Thursday 3 a.m. to 5 p.m. warns of 2.5 to 3.5 feet of inundation in low spots in Burien, Normandy Park and Des Moines. A wind advisory with 45 mph gusts reaches Kent and Auburn.

coming.h: Weekend tolls on SR 520 and SR 99 Thursday
coming.s: Weekend toll rates apply on Thanksgiving on SR 520 and the SR 99 tunnel. I-405 express toll lanes are free all day.

coming.h: Court filing portal targeted to return Monday
coming.s: King County expects KC Script back Nov. 30 if the vendor's security upgrades and county testing are finished.
